summary.text: María Isa Pérez-Vega is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 65B, first elected in 2022.

Her official House page lists committee assignments in Capital Investment, Children and Families Finance and Policy, and Education Finance, and gives her occupation as business owner and artist, with an education in cultural studies at Columbia College, Chicago.

sources.title: Rep. María Isa Pérez-Vega (65B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
